advanced-filter-description: Sefe se se tseneletseng se go letla go kwala mokwalo o o nang le diopereitara tse: == != <= >= && || ( ) Sekgala se kgaoganya diopereitara. O ka sefa mabala otlhe a a rulagantsweng ka maina le boleng jwa one. Sekai: Field1 == Value1. Fa mabala kgotsa boleng di na le dikgala, di tsenye mo matshwaong a nopolo a le mangwe. Sekai: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Dirisa backslash go tlola tlhaka e e laolang. Sekai: Field1 == I'm. O ka kopanya maemo a mantsi. Sekai: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Diopereitara di tlhalosiwa go tswa molemeng go ya mojeng; fetola thulaganyo ka masakana. Sekai: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). O ka batla mabala a mokwalo ka regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

import-board-instruction-kanboard: Manega JSON ya thomelo ya Kanboard: sedirwa se se nang le "columns" (kgotsa ditiro tse di nang le column_name) le lenaane la "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Dikholomo di nna manane, ditiro di nna dikarata.
import-board-instruction-deck: Manega JSON ya boto ya NextCloud Deck (boto e e nang le "stacks", nngwe le nngwe e na le "cards"). Ditlhopha di nna manane, dikarata di nna dikarata.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Manega JSON ya pokello ya diphuthelwana tsa tiro ya OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Maemo a nna manane, diphuthelwana tsa tiro di nna dikarata.
import-board-instruction-issues: Manega lenaane la JSON la dikgang tsa __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Dikgang di nna dikarata tse di kgaogantsweng ka manane a Bulegile / Tswetswe.
import-board-instruction-asana: Manega JSON ya thomelo ya ditiro tsa Asana ({ "data": [...] } go tswa thomelong ya Asana kgotsa GET /tasks). Ditiro di kgaoganngwa ka dikarolo (memberships); ditiro tse di weditsweng di ya kwa Feditswe.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Manega JSON ya thomelo ya lenaane la ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Dikgato di nna manane, dintlha di nna dikarata.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Kgomaretsa lenaane la ditiro tsa markdown (mokgwa o o dirisiwang ke didiriswa tsa markdown-kanban tse di jaaka Obsidian Kanban): ditlhogo tsa "## Leina la lenaane", ka dilo tsa "- [ ]"/"- [x]" ka fa tlase. Ditlhogo di nna manane mme dilo di nna dikarata.
import-board-instruction-leo: Kgomaretsa sebopego sa Leo (faele ya .leo). Dikarolo tsa maemo a a kwa godimo di nna manaane, dikarolo tse di leng ka fa tlase ga tsona ka tlhamalalo di nna dikarata, mme mokwalo wa karolo o nna tlhaloso ya karata. Dikarolo tsa maemo a a kwa teng go feta di nna manaane a tlhatlhobo. Dikarolo tse di tshwailweng di tsenngwa e le tse di weditsweng.
import-board-instruction-opml: Kgomaretsa thulaganyo ya OPML, jaaka Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq le di-outliner tse dingwe di e ntsha. Dintlha tsa maemo a a kwa godimo di nna manaane, bana ba tsona ba nna dikarata tse kitsiso e leng tlhaloso, mme dintlha tse di kwa tlase thata di nna manaane a tlhatlhobo. Dintlha tse di weditsweng di tsenngwa di feditswe.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Kgomaretsa faele ya Org mode, jaaka Emacs, Orgzly kgotsa Beorg di e kwala. Ditlhogo tsa maemo a ntlha di nna manaane mme ditlhogo tsa maemo a bobedi di nna dikarata. TODO le DONE, maemo a botlhokwa, ditshwao, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE le CLOSED di a bolokwa, mme mabokose a tshwao le ditlhogo tse di kwa tlase thata di nna manaane a tlhatlhobo.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Kgomaretsa faele ya todo.txt: tiro e le nngwe mo moleng mongwe le mongwe, jaaka tiriso ya todo.txt le ditiriso tse di tsamaelanang le yone di kwala. Ditiro tse di weditsweng ("x") di ya kwa karolong e e weditsweng, +project le @context di nna dileibole, (A) e nna leibole ya botlhokwa, mme due: le t: di nna matlha a bofelo le a tshimologo.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Kgomaretsa dipholo tsa task export: lenaane la JSON kgotsa tiro e le nngwe mo moleng mongwe le mongwe. Ditiro tse di weditsweng di ya kwa Done, project le priority di fetoga ditshwao, annotations e fetoga ditshwaelo, mme depends e fetoga go ikaega ka ditiro tse di thibelang.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Ntsha faele ya .boardarchive mo polokelong e e gateletsweng mme o kgomaretse diteng tsa board.jsonl ya boto, ka mola wa mofuta kgotsa ntle le one. Karolo ya go kgaoganya ka ditlhopha mo ponong ya boto e fetoga manaane, dikarolo tse dingwe tsa tlhopho di fetoga ditshwao, dikarolo tsa mokwalo le mabokose a go tshwaya di fetoga tlhaloso le lenaane la tlhatlhobo, mme ditshwaelo di a bolokwa. Ditshwantsho le difaele tse di mametleletsweng ga di tsenngwe.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Mo MeisterTask, tobetsa leina la porojeke, tlhopha Export project mme o ntshe CSV, go tswa foo o e kgomaretse. Dikarolo di nna manaane mme ditiro di nna dikarata, le dikitsiso tsa tsona, letlha la bofelo, moabelwa le ditshwao; ditiro tse di weditsweng di boloka letlha la go wediwa. CSV e e kwaletsweng go tsenngwa ga MeisterTask le yona e a dira.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Mo Obsidian, bula faele ya boto ya Kanban jaaka Markdown (kgotsa bula faele ya .md mo mokwaleng wa mafoko), go tswa foo o e kgomaretse yotlhe. Ditsela di nna manaane le ditekanyetso tsa tsona tsa dikarata, dikarata di boloka ditshwao, matlha, botlhokwa, mafelo le lenaane la tlhatlhobo, mme Archive e nna dikarata tse di isitsweng kwa polokelong.
import-board-instruction-linear: Mo Linear, ntsha mathata jaaka CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, kgotsa go ntsha ga ponelo), go tswa foo o kgomaretse CSV. Maemo a nna manaane, ditlhopha di nna ditsela, mme mathata a nna dikarata le moabelwa, ditshwao, matlha, bothata jwa motsadi, botlhokwa, kakanyetso, porojeke le potologo.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Mo TickTick, bula Settings, Account, Backup & Import mme o dire kopi ya polokelo, go tswa foo o kgomaretse faele ya CSV. Lenaane lengwe le lengwe la TickTick le nna tsela mme dikholomo tsa lona di nna manaane; ditiro di boloka ditshwao, matlha, lenaane la tlhatlhobo, botlhokwa le ditiro-potlana.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Mo ClickUp, ntsha ditiro jaaka CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, kgotsa go ntsha ga ponelo ya List kgotsa Table le dikholomo tsotlhe), go tswa foo o kgomaretse CSV. Maemo a nna manaane, manaane a ClickUp a nna ditsela, mme ditiro di nna dikarata le ditiro-potlana, baabelwa, ditshwao, matlha, botlhokwa le nako.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Mo Nullboard, bula boto, tlhopha Export this board... mo lenaaneng la ditlhopho, bula faele ya .nbx mo mokwaleng wa mafoko mme o kgomaretse diteng tsa yona. Manaane a nna manaane mme dikitsiso di nna dikarata: mola wa ntlha wa kitsiso ke setlhogo sa karata mme o o setseng ke tlhaloso ya yona. Kitsiso e e tala e newa leibole raw. Faele e e nang le diboto di le mmalwa e tsenya boto ya yona ya ntlha.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Mo Kanri, bula Import & Export mme o tlhophe Export individual board (kgotsa Export all data), go tswa foo o kgomaretse faele ya .json. Dikholomo di nna manaane mme dikarata di nna dikarata, le tlhaloso ya tsona, letlha la bofelo, ditshwao le mebala; ditiro tsa karata di nna lenaane la tlhatlhobo. Go tswa mo go ntsheng ga data yotlhe, boto ya ntlha e a tsenngwa.
import-board-instruction-planka: Kwala aterese ya Planka ya gago (sekao https://planka.example.com), leina la modirisi le lefoko la sephiri la Planka, morago o tobetse "Bontsha lenaane". Di dirisiwa fela go tsaya boto mme ga di bolokwe. Tlhopha boto mme o tobetse "Tsaya": WeKan e e bala go tswa mo API ya Planka, le manaane a yone, dikarata, ditlhaloso, malatsi a bofelo, dileibole, maloko, manaane a ditiro le dikakgelo, morago o tswelele go tsenya jaaka tlwaelo. Dikarata tse di mo polokelong ya Planka di tsenngwa di le mo polokelong; dikgomaretso le dikarata tse di mo matlakaleng ga di tsenngwe.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: Mo Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), tsena, dumela tetla ya Tasks.Read mme o kopolole token go tswa mo tab ya Access token. E kgomaretse fano mme o tobetse "Bontsha lenaane"; token e dirisiwa fela go tsaya mo mme ga e bolokwe. Tlhopha manaane otlhe kgotsa lenaane le le lengwe mme o tobetse "Tsaya". Lenaane lengwe le lengwe la To Do le nna lenaane mme tiro nngwe le nngwe e nna karata, le dintlha, malatsi a bofelo le a go simolola, dikgato jaaka lenaane la tlhatlhobo, ditlhopha jaaka dileibole, botlhokwa jo bogolo le maemo jaaka dileibole; ditiro tse di weditsweng di isiwa kwa polokelong. Dikgakololo le dipoeletso ga di tsenngwe.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: Mo KanbanFlow, bula menu ya boto, tlhopha Settings → API & Webhooks mme o kopolole token ya API ya boto. Kgomaretsa token fano, tobetsa "Bontsha lenaane", tlhopha boto mme o tobetse "Tsaya"; token e dirisiwa fela go tsaya moo mme ga e bolokwe. Dikholomo di nna manaane mme ditsela di nna ditsela; ditiro di boloka tlhaloso, mmala, dileibole, letsatsi la bofelo, ditironnyane jaaka lenaane la tlhatlhobo, nako e e dirisitsweng, khakanyo, batho le dikakgelo.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Kwala ID ya akhaonto ya gago ya Basecamp (nomoro e e latelang basecamp.com/ mo atereseng) le token ya phitlhelelo (go tswa mo app ya OAuth 2 e e kwadisitsweng kwa launchpad.37signals.com, kgotsa e kopanyo e e leng teng e setseng e na le yone), tobetsa "Bontsha lenaane", tlhopha porojeke mme o tobetse "Tsaya". Token e dirisiwa fela go tsaya moo mme ga e bolokwe. Tafole nngwe le nngwe ya dikarata e nna tsela e dikholomo tsa yone e le manaane, mme manaane a dilo tse di tshwanetseng go dirwa a nna tsela ya "To-dos"; dikarata le dilo tse di tshwanetseng go dirwa di boloka mokwalo, malatsi, ba ba abetsweng le dikakgelo, dikgato tsa karata di nna lenaane la tlhatlhobo, mme tse di weditsweng di isiwa kwa polokelong.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Bona token ya phitlhelelo go tswa mo OAuth 2.0 Playground: ka fa tlase ga Tasks API v1 tlhopha tasks.readonly, tobetsa Authorize APIs, morago Exchange authorization code for tokens, mme o kopolole access token. E kgomaretse fano mme o tobetse "Bontsha lenaane", tlhopha manaane otlhe a ditiro kgotsa le le lengwe, morago "Tsaya". Token e dirisiwa fela go tsaya mo mme ga e bolokwe. Manaane a ditiro a nna manaane mme ditiro di nna dikarata, le dintlha, dikgolagano le letsatsi la bofelo; ditironnyane di nna lenaane la tlhatlhobo mme ditiro tse di weditsweng di tsenngwa di le mo polokelong.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: API ya Google Keep ke ya diakhaonto tsa Google Workspace fela. Bona token ya phitlhelelo ya OAuth 2.0 e e nang le scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (mo OAuth 2.0 Playground fa motsamaisi wa Workspace a letla, kgotsa go tswa mo service account e e nang le thomelo ya domain yotlhe), e kgomaretse, tobetsa "Bontsha lenaane" mme morago "Tsaya". Token e dirisiwa fela go tsaya mo mme ga e bolokwe. Dintlha tsa mokwalo di nna dikarata mo lenaaneng la "Notes", mme dintlha tsa lenaane la tlhatlhobo di nna dikarata mo lenaaneng la "Lists" le dilo tsa tsone jaaka lenaane la tlhatlhobo. Dintlha tse di mo matlakaleng, dikgomaretso le go abelana ga di tsenngwe.
api-import-desc: E tsee mo tirelong ka akhaonto ya gago. Se o se kwalang fano se dirisiwa fela go tsaya mo mme ga se bolokwe.
api-import-fetched: E tsere. Tlhatlhoba maloko a a fa tlase mme o tsenye.
api-import-nothing: Ga go na sepe se se ka tsenngwang ka akhaonto e.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Mo Pivotal Tracker, bula tsebe ya MORE ya porojeke mme o tlhophe Export CSV (kgotsa tlhopha dikgang mme o tlhophe Bulk Actions, CSV), go tswa foo o kgomaretse CSV. Boemo bongwe le bongwe jwa kgang bo nna lenaane mme dikgang di nna dikarata, le mofuta wa tsona le ditshwao, beng, mokopi, matlha, ditshwaelo, ditiro le dikgoreletsi; Estimate e nna Story points mme dipoeletso di nna di-sprint.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Mo Tasks.org, bula Settings, Backups mme o tlhophe Export tasks, go tswa foo o kgomaretse diteng tsa faele eo ya .json. Manaane a nna manaane mme ditiro di nna dikarata, le dikitsiso tsa tsona, ditshwao, matlha, ditshwaelo le ditiro-potlana; ditiro tse di weditsweng di boloka letlha la go wediwa, mme botlhokwa bo nna lebala le le rulagantsweng.
import-board-instruction-monday: Mo monday.com, bula lenaane la ditlhopho la boto, tlhopha More actions le Export board to Excel (le dintšhwafatso le dintlha-potlana fa o rata), go tswa foo o tlhophe faele eo ya .xlsx. Kholomo ya Status e nna manaane mme ditlhopha di nna ditsela; batho, matlha, molelwane wa nako le ditshwao di boloka mafelo a tsona, dikholomo tse dingwe di nna mafelo a a rulagantsweng mme dintšhwafatso di nna ditshwaelo.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Mo Super Productivity, bula Settings, go tswa foo Sync & Backup, tlhopha Export Data mme o kgomaretse diteng tsa faele ya sp-backup .json. Porojeke nngwe le nngwe e nna tsela mme ditiro di nna dikarata mo To Do, In Progress, Backlog kgotsa Done, le dikitsiso tsa tsona, ditshwao, letlha la bofelo, nako e e dirisitsweng le ditiro-potlana; ditiro tse di isitsweng kwa polokelong di nna dikarata tse di isitsweng kwa polokelong.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Mo Taiga, bula Admin > Project > Export mme o folose kopi ya porojeke (bula faele ya .json.gz pele), go tswa foo o kgomaretse JSON ya yona. Maemo a dikgang tsa badirisi a nna manaane, dikgang tsa badirisi di nna dikarata le ditiro tsa tsona jaaka ditiro-potlana, di-epic le mathata di newa ditsela tsa tsona, mme di-sprint, ditshwao, ditshwaelo le dinonofi tse di rulagantsweng di tla le tsona. Tse di tshwaraganeng ga di tsenngwe.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Mo Vikunja, bula Settings, tlhopha Data Export mme o folose faele ya .zip e e go e romelang, go tswa foo o tlhophe faele eo, kgotsa o kgomaretse data.json e e mo teng ga yona. Mabekere a Kanban a nna manaane mme ditiro di nna dikarata, le ditshwao tsa tsona, baabelwa, matlha, tlhaloso, manaane a ditiro jaaka manaane a tlhatlhobo le ditshwaelo; botlhokwa, phesente e e weditsweng le go wediwa di nna mafelo a a rulagantsweng. Tse di tshwaraganeng ga di tsenngwe.
import-board-instruction-quire: Mo Quire, bula lenaane la ditlhopho la porojeke mme o tlhophe Export CSV, go tswa foo o kgomaretse CSV. Maemo a nna manaane mme ditiro di nna dikarata, le ditiro-potlana tsa tsona jaaka dikarata tsa bana, baabelwa, ditshwao jaaka dileibole, matlha a go simolola, a bofelo le a go wediwa, tlhaloso le botlhokwa jaaka lebala le le rulagantsweng. Ditshwaelo le tse di tshwaraganeng ga di mo CSV ya Quire.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Mo Wrike, ntsha porojeke kgotsa foltara kwa Excel, kgotsa tlatsa sekao sa Excel sa go tsenya sa Wrike, go tswa foo o tlhophe faele eo ya .xlsx. Mela ya foltara le porojeke e nna ditsela, Status e nna manaane mme ditiro di nna dikarata, le Key ya tsona, tiro ya motsadi, baabelwa, matlha a go simolola le a bofelo, dikgolagano le tlhaloso; Priority, Duration le dikholomo tse dingwe di nna mafelo a a rulagantsweng.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Mo Teamwork.com, tlatsa sekao sa Excel sa go tsenya ditiro (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) mme o se boloke jaaka .xlsx, go tswa foo o tlhophe faele eo. Manaane a ditiro a nna manaane mme ditiro di nna dikarata; tiro e e simololang ka -, # kgotsa > e nna tiro-potlana ya tiro e e kwa godimo ga yona (--, ## kgotsa >> legato le le lengwe kwa tlase). Baabelwa, matlha le ditshwao di boloka mafelo a tsona; Priority, Estimated time le Complete di nna mafelo a a rulagantsweng.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Mo Businessmap (pele e ne e le Kanbanize), bula Advanced Search, tlhopha Configure results go tlhopha dikholomo, folosa faele ya Excel, go tswa foo o tlhophe faele eo ya .xlsx. Dikholomo di balwa ka maina a tsona a Seesemane (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): fa akhaonto ya gago e dirisa puo e nngwe, fetola maina a mola wa ditlhogo go nna Seesemane pele. Column e nna manaane mme Lane e nna ditsela; beng, ditshwao, mmala, matlha, ditshwaelo le dikgokagano tsa batsadi di boloka mafelo a tsona, mme Priority, Size, Type le dikholomo tse dingwe di nna mafelo a a rulagantsweng.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Mo Redmine, bula Issues ya porojeke, tlhopha Also available in: CSV kwa tlase ga lenaane, tlhopha dikholomo (All columns, le Description) mme o ntshe, go tswa foo o kgomaretse CSV. Redmine e fa dikholomo maina ka puo ya gago, ka jalo baya puo ya gago go nna Seesemane mo My account pele o ntsha. Boemo bongwe le bongwe bo nna lenaane mme mathata a nna dikarata, le tracker jaaka leibole, moabelwa, mokwadi, matlha, tiro ya motsadi le mathata a a amanang; botlhokwa, setlhopha, bešene e e lebeletsweng, nako e e akanyeditsweng, % Done le mafelo a a rulagantsweng di nna mafelo a a rulagantsweng.
import-board-instruction-notion: Mo Notion, bula database jaaka tsebe e e tletseng, tlhopha ••• le Export, tlhopha Markdown & CSV, mme o tlhophe faele ya .zip e e e folosang, kgotsa CSV e le nngwe ya database go tswa mo go yona, kgotsa o kgomaretse CSV eo. Kholomo e e bidiwang Status e nna manaane (fa e seyo, kholomo ya ntlha e e lebegang e le select e a dira, mme pego ya go tsenya e bolela gore ke efe); mela e nna dikarata le setlhogo sa tsona, ditshwao jaaka dileibole, batho jaaka maloko, matlha, le mokwalo wa tsebe jaaka tlhaloso; dikholomo tse dingwe di nna mafelo a a rulagantsweng. Dikamano, ditshwantsho le tse di tshwaraganeng ga di tsenngwe.
import-board-instruction-plane: Mo Plane, bula Workspace Settings, tlhopha Exports, ntsha diporojeke jaaka JSON, CSV kgotsa Excel mme o folose faele ya .zip, go tswa foo o tlhophe faele eo, kgotsa faele e le nngwe e e mo teng ga yona, kgotsa o kgomaretse JSON kgotsa CSV. Maemo a nna manaane, diporojeke di nna ditsela, mme mathata a nna dikarata le setshupi sa tsona, motsadi, baabelwa, ditshwao, matlha, dikgokagano le ditshwaelo; botlhokwa, kakanyetso, potologo le karolo di nna mafelo a a rulagantsweng. Go ntsha ga Plane ga go na ditlhaloso kgotsa tse di tshwaraganeng, ka jalo ga di tsenngwe.
import-board-instruction-trello: Mo botong ya gago ya Trello, ya kwa 'Menu', morago 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', mme o kopise mokwalo o o tlhagelelang.

globalSearch-instructions-description: Dipatlisiso ka kgona include badiri go refine batla. Badiri di e tlhalositswe ka writing modiri leina le boleng kgaogantswe ka e colon. Go sekai, e modiri specification ya `lenaane:E thibetswe` would tekanyetso batla go dikarata seo di contained mo e lenaane named *E thibetswe*. Fa boleng e na le dibaka kgotsa special ditlhaka sona tshwanetse nna enclosed mo quotation marks (e.g. `__operator_list__:"Go Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-board: `__operator_board__:<title>` - dikarata mo diboto e e tsamaelanang e tlhalositswe *<title>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-list: `__operator_list__:<title>` - dikarata mo manane e e tsamaelanang e tlhalositswe *<title>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-swiml: `__operator_swimlane__:<title>` - dikarata mo ditsela e e tsamaelanang e tlhalositswe *<title>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-comme: `__operator_comment__:<text>` - dikarata ka e tlhaloso e e nang le *<text>*.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - dikarata seo na le e letshwao e e tsamaelanang *<color>* kgotsa *<name>
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - dikarata belonging go e boto e abetswe go mokgatlho *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - dikarata belonging go e boto e abetswe go setlhopha *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - dikarata e leng di bofelo up go *<n>* malatsi go tswa jaanong. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ manane dikarata tsotlhe past tsa bone letlha la bofelo.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - dikarata e leng were e dirilwe *<n>* malatsi ago kgotsa less
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - dikarata e leng were e fetotswe *<n>* malatsi ago kgotsa less
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - tsotlhe e bolokilweng le unarchived dikarata
globalSearch-instructions-status-ended: `__predicate_ended__` - dikarata ka e letlha la bofelo
globalSearch-instructions-status-public: `__predicate_public__` - dikarata fela mo ya botlhe diboto
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - kwa *<field>* ke nngwe ya `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` kgotsa `__predicate_member__`. Placing e `-` mo front ya *<field>* dipatlisiso go absence ya e boleng mo seo lefelo (e.g. `e na le:-bofelo` dipatlisiso go dikarata ntle le e letlha la bofelo).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - kwa *<sort-name>* ke nngwe ya `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` kgotsa `__predicate_modified__`. Go e descending rulaganya, place e `-` mo front ya rulaganya leina.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - kwa *<n>* ke e e siameng integer expressing palo ya dikarata go nna displayed ka nngwe tsebe.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: Multiple badiri ka nna e tlhalositswe.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Similar badiri di *OR*ed together. Dikarata seo tshwantsha le fa e le efe ya conditions tla nna returned.
`__operator_list__:E teng __operator_list__:E thibetswe` would return dikarata contained mo le fa e le efe lenaane named *E thibetswe* kgotsa *E teng*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Differing badiri di *AND*ed together. Fela dikarata seo tshwantsha tsotlhe ya differing badiri di returned. `__operator_list__:E teng __operator_label__:red` returns fela dikarata mo lenaane *E teng* ka e *red* letshwao.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Malatsi ka kgona nna e tlhalositswe jaaka e e siameng kgotsa negative integer kgotsa using `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` kgotsa `__predicate_year__` go ya jaanong period.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Ka ya tlwaelo e bolokilweng dikarata di ga searched.

database-migration-description: Hudusa text-based tshedimosetso (everything except dilo tse di tshwaraganeng le ditshwantsho tsa batho, e leng stay mo tsamaiso ya difaele) magareng MongoDB le FerretDB v1 (SQLite). nngwe polokelotshedimosetso tshwanetse nna e a tsamaya le reachable (ya tlwaelo ports: FerretDB MongoDB://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB MongoDB://127.0.0.1:27019; override ka WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Morago sona finishes, point MONGO_URL kwa nngwe polokelotshedimosetso le restart WeKan (mo Snap: snap beakanya wekan polokelotshedimosetso=ferretdb kgotsa =MongoDB).

sandstorm-migration-description: Fa WeKan runs mo teng e Sandstorm grain, ya sona kgale MongoDB 3 polokelotshedimosetso ke e hudusitswe go FerretDB v1 (SQLite) mo ntlha launch, le dilo tse di tshwaraganeng le ditshwantsho tsa batho di e sutisitswe go tswa polokelotshedimosetso go grain's difaele/dilo tse di tshwaraganeng le difaele/ditshwantsho tsa batho directories. Eno bontsha whether seo khuduso succeeded le how much disiki sebaka kgale e e sa baakanngwang MongoDB polokelotshedimosetso difaele sa ntse dirisa mo teng grain, le lets wena phimola tseo e e sa baakanngwang difaele go mahala sebaka.

card-field-visibility-desc: Mafelo a Dipeakanyo tsa Boto / Karata a diboto di ka a bontshang. Lebala le le sa tshwaiwang le fitlhiwa mo karateng nngwe le nngwe, karateng-potlana le mo Dipeakanyong tsa Boto / Karata tsa boto nngwe le nngwe. Ga go data ya karata kgotsa peakanyo ya boto e e fetogang, mme go le tshwaya gape go bontsha boto nngwe le nngwe jaaka e ne e beilwe. Thulaganyo ya mafelo ke ya boto nngwe le nngwe.
cards-loading-auto: Ya boitiriso (bonya fela go big diboto)
cards-loading-description: WeKan loads boto dikarata ka boitiriso: e big boto (over bogolo threshold) loads fela dikarata currently bonalang (infinite scroll) plus e live palo, jalo sona stays fast le e dirisa less segopotso le bandwidth, fa smaller diboto laisa nngwe le nngwe karata go simplest, fully featured experience. Foo ke ga go sepe go configure. Badiri ka kgona sa ntse pateletsa e mokgwa ka CARDS_LOADING (tsotlhe/bonya/auto) le CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD environment variables.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Bonya karata e a laisa ke experimental: karata counters le WIP ditekanyetso di accurate, but Calendar/Table/Gantt views le multi-select reflect fela dikarata loaded jalo far. Reload bula diboto morago changing eno.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Fa e tshubilwe, tsotlhe dikgokagano (both Markdown dikgokagano jaaka [letshwao](url) le e e sa baakanngwang HTML <a href> ditshwao) di ka metlha bontshitswe jaaka tlwaelegileng, non-clickable mokwalwa mo nngwe le nngwe rich mokwalwa lefelo (boto le karata ditlhogo, ditlhaloso, ditlhaloso, checklists, etc.). Eno prevents misleading e e ka tobetswang dikgokagano. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe, jalo dikgokagano stay e e ka tobetswang.
always-show-code-as-text: Ka metlha bontsha tsotlhe khoutu jaaka tlwaelegileng mokwalwa
always-show-code-as-text-description: Fa e tshubilwe, rich mokwalwa ke le ka motlha rendered jaaka Markdown kgotsa HTML: entire motswedi ke ka metlha bontshitswe jaaka tlwaelegileng mokwalwa mo nngwe le nngwe rich mokwalwa lefelo (boto le karata ditlhogo, ditlhaloso, ditlhaloso, checklists, etc.). Eno reveals e fitlhilwe diteng — HTML ditlhaloso (<!-- -->), target ya Markdown dikgokagano, JavaScript le le fa e le efe nngwe khoutu — jalo tsotlhe khoutu ke ka metlha bonalang, ga e e ka tobetswang, le ga e a tsamaya. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe, jalo Markdown ke rendered normally.
disable-all-import-description: Fa e tshubilwe, tsotlhe tlisa features di turned timilwe: go tlisa e boto go tswa WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea le Forgejo, jaaka well jaaka cloning e boto. tlisa menu options di e fitlhilwe le seabi rejects le fa e le efe tlisa kopo. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.
disable-all-export-description: Fa e tshubilwe, tsotlhe romelela kwa ntle features di turned timilwe: go romelela kwa ntle e boto jaaka WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, kgotsa go NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, le single-attachment romelela kwa ntle. romelela kwa ntle menu options di e fitlhilwe le seabi rejects le fa e le efe romelela kwa ntle kopo. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.
disable-import-avatars-description: Fa e tshubilwe, ditshwantsho tsa batho (modirisi profile pictures) di le ka motlha e tlisitswe. Eno covers WeKan JSON tlisa, Trello tlisa, le setshwantsho sa motho rulaganya mmogo go tswa external identity providers mo go tsena (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Names le nngwe tshedimosetso di sa ntse e tlisitswe; fela ditshwantsho tsa batho di skipped. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.
disable-export-avatars: Tima romelela kwa ntle ditshwantsho tsa batho
disable-export-avatars-description: Fa e tshubilwe, ditshwantsho tsa batho (modirisi profile pictures) di le ka motlha included fa go romelela kwa ntle e boto (WeKan JSON le CSV romelela kwa ntle). Usernames le nngwe tshedimosetso di sa ntse e rometswe kwa ntle; fela ditshwantsho tsa batho di omitted. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.
anonymize-import-users-description: Fa e tshubilwe, go tlisa e WeKan JSON boto emisetsa nngwe le nngwe e tlisitswe user's leina la modirisi, tletse leina le initials ka sebaledi placeholders (modirisi1, modirisi2,...), drops tsa bone setshwantsho sa motho, le rewrites @leina la modirisi mentions (le requested-by / assigned-by mafelo) mo teng e tlisitswe karata le tlhaloso diteng. Nnyaa real modirisi identity go tswa motswedi boto ke e bolokilwe. word "modirisi" e latela puo ya motho go tlisa. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.

disable-activities-description: Fa e tshubilwe, activity-feed entries di le ka motlha rekotilwe le le ka motlha bontshitswe anywhere (boto bara ya letlhakore le karata tiragalo tab). Nnyaa hisetori ya who did eng ke kept. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.
disable-notifications-description: Fa e tshubilwe, WeKan le ka motlha sends lebelela dikitsiso (in-app, imeile kgotsa nngwe services) go le fa e le efe tiragalo. Ditiragalo ka kgona sa ntse nna rekotilwe (unless also e timilwe fa godimo); fela dikitsiso di suppressed. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.
disable-watch-description: Fa e tshubilwe, lebelela feature ke turned timilwe — badirisi ga e kgone subscribe go diboto, manane kgotsa dikarata go amogela dikitsiso, le le fa e le efe attempt go fetola e lebelela level ke rejected. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.
backup-description: Dira bekapo ya difaele tse di kgomareditsweng, ditshwantsho tsa badirisi le/kgotsa tshedimosetso (dikgobokanyo tsotlhe tsa mokwalo tse e seng difaele tse di kgomareditsweng kgotsa ditshwantsho tsa badirisi). Faele ya .zip e romelwa ka tlhamalalo kwa polokelong e e tlhophilweng, ntle le faele ya nakwana, jaaka backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, e e nang le YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars le /data. Mabolokelo a leru (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) a dirisa dintlha tsa tetla tse di rulagantsweng mo dithebeng tsa one tsa polokelo.
backup-scope-description: whole tiragalo, kgotsa nngwe Mokgatlho. E Organization's bekapo e na le ya sona diboto le everything mo bone, including dilo tse di tshwaraganeng ya tseo diboto — but nnyaa modirisi diakhaonto le nnyaa tiragalo dithulaganyo, because tseo di aroganetswe ka nngwe le nngwe Mokgatlho. Restoring e Organization's bekapo fela ever writes go diboto seo Mokgatlho owns.

E dira mmogo le bekapo e e rulaganyeditsweng nako, e e dirang mabolokelo a a feletseng.

continuous-backup-target: Foldara e go yang kwa go yone (tsela e e feletseng mo disiking e nngwe, mo lefelong le le abelanwang la netweke kgotsa mo lefelong le le golagantsweng ka rclone)

continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Ditsebe tsa SQLite (ditsebe tse di fetogileng mo pakeng nngwe le nngwe)

continuous-backup-saved: Dithulaganyo tsa bekapo e e tswelelang di bolokilwe

Molaetsa o o setseng o simolotse go romelwa ga o ka ke wa busediwa morago, mme go romela mo go nang le dipholo tse di sa tlhomamang go ka boelediwa. Go palelwa ga leruri le melaetsa e e fitlheletseng tekanyetso ya maiteko di sala gore di sekasekiwe. Go leka gape melaetsa e e paletsweng go simolola modikologo o mosha wa maiteko mme go boloka go ema nakwana mo go setseng go le teng.

rule-email-recovery-invalid: Tshedimosetso e e tlhalosang teko ga e a siama

rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Ga go a kgonega go tsenya maiteko a imeile a melao. Ntšhwafatsa go leka gape.

E latlhe go letla lenaane go dira Sync gape: diphetogo tse di setseng di dirisitswe di a nna, diphetogo tse di setseng tse di bolokilweng ga di ke di kwalwa, mme Sync e e latelang e bapisa lenaane le motswedi wa lona gape.

feature-views-version-control-desc: Boto jaaka setshedi sa mathata sa GitHub kgotsa Gitea: dikarata jaaka mathata, ditshwao le maemo a botlhokwa, dikakgelo jaaka puisano, tse di tshwaraganeng jaaka difaele, le hisetori ya boto e e nang le go busetsa.
vcs-sort-updated-desc: Tse di sa tswang go ntšhwafadiwa
vcs-sort-comments-desc: Tse di nang le dikakgelo di le dintsi
vcs-open-issues: Mathata a le %s a a butsweng
vcs-no-due-date: Ga go na letlha la bofelo
vcs-no-issues: Ga go na mathata a a tsamaisanang le patlo e.
vcs-no-milestones: Ga go ise go nne le maemo a botlhokwa. Setshwao se se nang le letlha la bofelo ke maemo a botlhokwa.
vcs-no-labels: Ga go ise go nne le ditshwao.
vcs-no-files: Ga go ise go nne le difaele.
vcs-no-list: Boto e ga e na lenaane kgotsa tsela ya bothata.
card-qr-code-desc: E sekene go bula karata e mo mogaleng kgotsa thebolete.
card-qr-code-too-long: Kgokagano ya karata e e leele thata go khoutu ya QR.
vcs-no-releases: Ga go ise go nne le tse di ntshitsweng.
vcs-no-wiki: Ga go ise go nne le wiki. Go tsenya setheo sa GitHub go tlisa wiki ya polokelo ya khoutu fa.
github-org-import-desc: Polokelo nngwe le nngwe ya setheo kgotsa ya modirisi e nna boto ya yone, e e bulwang mo Pono ya boto / Taolo ya diphetolelo: mathata a yone le dikakgelo, ditshwao le difaele tsa one, tse di ntshitsweng ke yone, ditsamaiso tsa tiro tsa GitHub Actions jaaka Melao, le wiki ya yone.
github-org-import-token-hint: E a tlhokega mo dipolokelong tsa poraefete le moleganong o o kwa godimo wa API. E dirisiwa fela fa go tsenya go ntse go tsamaya mme ga e ke e bolokiwa.
github-org-import-issues: Mathata, le dikakgelo, ditshwao le difaele
github-org-import-release-files: Difaele tse di ntshitsweng (di ka nna dikgolo)
github-org-import-actions: Ditsamaiso tsa tiro tsa GitHub Actions jaaka Melao
github-org-import-result: Mathata a le %s, tse di ntshitsweng di le %s, melao e le %s, ditsebe tsa wiki di le %s
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Kwala leina la setheo kgotsa la modirisi, kgotsa aterese ya lone ya GitHub.
github-org-import-no-repos: Ga go na dipolokelo tse di ka tsenngwang.
github-org-import-running: Go tsenya setheo go setse go ntse go tsamaya.
optional-apis-desc: Di-REST API tse di mo sebopegong sa di-API tsa ditshedi tse dingwe, gore diapo le dikripiti tsa tsone di kgone go dirisa WeKan e jaaka bokafamorago jwa tsone: se di se bolokang se bolokwa mo WeKan, mo dibotong tsa WeKan. Nngwe le nngwe e tingwa go fitlha e tshwailwe fano. Ga go na epe e e nang le ditshwanelo tsa yone: moreki o tsena ka token ya WeKan API mme a ka bona le go fetola fela se motho yoo a ka se bonang le go se fetola mo WeKan. Tsotlhe di tlhoka gore WeKan REST API e bo e butswe (WITH_API=true). Aterese e e kwa tlase ga nngwe le nngwe ke e moreki a e dirisang jaaka sefa sa gagwe.
optional-api-trello: API e e dumalanang le Trello
optional-api-trello-desc: Diapo le dikripiti tse di kwaletsweng REST API ya Trello (sekai Trellinator) di dira le WeKan: diboto, manaane, dikarata, ditshwao, maloko, dikakgelo le manaane a tlhatlhobo. Token ya Trello ke token ya WeKan API. Go phimola karata go e isa kwa polokelong mo WeKan.
optional-api-jira: API e e dumalanang le Jira
optional-api-jira-desc: Bareki ba REST API v2 ya Jira ba dira le WeKan: porojeke ke boto (senotlolo sa yone ke senotlolo sa boto), bothata ke karata (DEV-7), maemo ke lenaane, mme phetogo e tsamaisa karata. Patlo e amogela JQL e e motlhofo: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text le ORDER BY. Tsena ka token ya WeKan API jaaka lefoko la sephiri. Go phimola bothata go bo isa kwa polokelong.
optional-api-github: API e e dumalanang le GitHub
optional-api-github-desc: Bareki ba REST API ya GitHub ya mathata ba dira le WeKan: polokelo ya khoutu ke boto, bothata ke karata, le ditshwao, maemo a botlhokwa (ditshwao tse di nang le letlha la bofelo), dikakgelo, le e butswe kgotsa e tswetswe jaaka mo Taolong ya diphetolelo. Token ke token ya WeKan API.
optional-api-gitea: API e e dumalanang le Gitea
optional-api-gitea-desc: Bareki ba REST API ya Gitea le Forgejo ya mathata ba dira le WeKan, ka tsela e e tshwanang le API e e dumalanang le GitHub: polokelo ya khoutu ke boto mme bothata ke karata. Token ke token ya WeKan API.
bots-none: Ga go ise go nne le dibote. Bote ke mmerekisi mo sebeleding sa gago - moemedi wa AI, tiro ya CI, sekripi - yo boto e e mo neelang dikarata.
bots-token: Thokene ya go saena (ga e patelesege)
bots-no-runs: Ga go na bote e e berekang jaanong.
bots-summary: %s di a bereka · %s di go emetse
bot-not-found: Bote eo ga e mo botong e.
bot-option-not-found: Karabo eo ga se nngwe ya tse bote e di neileng.
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: Dikgokagano tsa webe tse di tswang ga di a letlelelwa go fitlha diaterese mo neteweking ya WeKan ka boyone, gore go se nne ope yo o ka supang kgokagano ya webe ya boto kwa tirelong ya ka fa gare. Kwala fano di-host tse di mo neteweking eo tse dikgokagano tsa webe di letlelelwang go di fitlha - Node-RED, seva ya puisano - nngwe mo moleng mongwe le mongwe, jaaka leina kgotsa aterese, le phoro go letla phoro eo fela. E se nang sepe: ga go ope. Ke batsamaisi ba saete fela ba ba ka fetolang lenane leno.
account-webhook: Webhook ya go tsena le go ikwadisa
account-webhook-desc: Aterese e le nngwe e WeKan e e itsiseng fa mongwe a tsena kgotsa akhaonto e ntšhwa e dirwa. Ga go romelwe sepe go fitlha tiragalo e e kwa tlase e tshwailwe. E rwala tiragalo, leina la modirisi le nako; tshwaya mafelo a mangwe fela fa moamogedi a a tlhoka.
account-webhook-on-register: Fa akhaonto e ntšhwa e dirwa
account-webhook-field-ip: Aterese ya IP e go tsena go tswang kwa go yone
webhook-internal-hosts-rejected: Ga se host, ga e a bolokwa:
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: Khansela dikitsiso tsotlhe tse di emetseng tsa ditiro tse di feteng malatsi a le kae?
activity-recovery-bulk-result: Di khanseletswe %s, di romeletswe %s, %s tsa bogologolo di sa ntse di emetse.
vcs-synced-from: E tsamaisantswe go tswa go %s: e bule o bo o e tswale koo.
vcs-synced-issue: Bothata jono bo tsamaisantswe: bo bule o bo o bo tswale mo setshaloking sa jone.
sync-write-back: Kwala diphetogo morago kwa GitLab: setlhogo, tlhaloso, dikakgelo, go tswala le go bula gape
sync-write-back-error: Go kwala morago kwa GitLab go paletswe
email-bounces-description: Se WeKan e se dirang ka imeile e e boang: aterese e e kwadilweng phoso, lebokoso la poso le le tletseng, karabo ya go se nne kwa ofising, ngongorego ya spam. Mofuta mongwe le mongwe o na le ditiro tsa one, tse di dirwang fa o sena go boa makgetlo a le kalo.
email-bounces-enabled: Laola di-imeile tse di boileng mo WeKan
email-bounces-action-stop-email: Emisa go romela imeile kwa atereseng
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: Aterese ga e yo: phoso ya go kwala, akhaonto e e phimotsweng, domeine e e sa itsiweng.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: Ga e a romelwa ga jaana: lebokoso le tletse, sebereka se tshwaregile. Fela tse dintsi di latelana di na le bokao.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Dikarabo tsa go se nne kwa ofising, malatsi a boikhutso kgotsa tsa thulaganyo ya ditekete. Imeile e gorositswe.
email-bounces-category-complaint-desc: Moamogedi o tshwaile imeile e le spam.
email-bounces-ses-description: Mo Amazon SES, romela dikitsiso tsa Bounce le Complaint, le molao wa kamogelo wa aterese e WeKan e romelang go tswa go yone, kwa setlhogong sa SNS, mme o kwadise aterese e go sone ka HTTPS:
email-bounces-ses-topics: Di-ARN tsa ditlhogo tsa SNS tse di amogelwang, nngwe mo moleng mongwe le mongwe
email-bounces-stopped-only: Fela diaterese tse WeKan e sa tlholeng e di romelela imeile
email-bounces-clear-hint: Lebala go boa ga aterese e mme o e romelele imeile gape
email-bounce-invalid-topic: Seo ga se ARN ya setlhogo sa SNS.
email-bounces-providers: Ditirelo tse dingwe tsa go romela
email-bounces-providers-description: Fa WeKan e romela ka nngwe ya ditirelo tse, e tshube, o neye tirelo aterese eno ya webhook ya ditiragalo tsa yone tsa di-imeile tse di boileng le dingongorego tsa spam, mme o kgomaretse fano senotlolo se e di saenang ka sone, kgotsa lefoko la sephiri le o le tsentseng mo atereseng jaaka https://user:password@… kgotsa ?secret=…
email-bounces-provider-key: Senotlolo sa go saena sa webhook
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: Tirelo e e tshubilweng e tlhoka senotlolo sa yone sa go saena kgotsa lefoko la sephiri.
activity-pub-enabled: Diboto tsa phatlhalatsa di phasalatsa ditiro tsa dikarata tsa tsone mo fediverse (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: E timilwe ka tlwaelo. Fa e tshubilwe, boto nngwe le nngwe ya phatlhalatsa e ka latelwa go tswa kwa Mastodon le diseva tse dingwe tsa fediverse jaaka @board-<id> mo atereseng ya WeKan eno, mme ditiro tse dintšhwa tsa dikarata di fitlha kwa balateding ba yone. Ke ya go bala fela: ga go sepe se seva ya fediverse e se romelang se fetolang boto, mme diboto tsa sephiri ga di ke di phasalatswa.
caldav-sync-desc: Tsenya matlha a bofelo a dikarata tsa boto eno mo khalendareng - Nextcloud Calendar kgotsa khalendara epe fela ya CalDAV. Letlha la bofelo le le sutisitsweng mo khalendareng le boela mo karateng. Dirisa lefoko la sephiri la tiriso, e seng la gago.
caldav-enabled: Tsamaisa matlha a bofelo le khalendara eno
caldav-invalid-url: Aterese ya khalendara e tshwanetse go nna aterese ya http:// kgotsa https://, e se na leina la modirisi kgotsa lefoko la sephiri mo go yone.
caldav-not-linked: Pele, boloka aterese ya khalendara mme o tshube go tsamaisana.
webdav-storage-description: Boloka tse di tshwaraganeng mo foltareng mo seveng ya WebDAV - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud kgotsa epe fela e nngwe. Dirisa lefoko la sephiri la tiriso le le diretsweng WeKan. Seva e e mo neteweking ya WeKan ka boyone e ka dirisiwa fano, ka gonne ke motsamaisi wa saete fela yo o tlhomang aterese eno.
sqrl-desc: E timilwe ka tlwaelo. Fa e tshubilwe, tsebe ya go tsena e neela SQRL, mme maloko a simolola ka go tsenya boitshupo jwa bona jwa SQRL mo Dipeakanyong tsa leloko. SQRL e tlhoka gore WeKan e nne mo atereseng ya https://.
sqrl-scan: Sekena khoutu ka app ya gago ya SQRL, kgotsa o bule moreki wa gago wa SQRL mo sedirisiweng se.
sqrl-expired: Khoutu e ya SQRL e fetile nako. Simolola sešwa.
sqrl-sign-in-failed: Go tsena ka SQRL go paletswe.
sqrl-needs-https: SQRL e tlhoka gore WeKan e nne mo atereseng ya https://.
sqrl-description: Tsena ka boitshupo jwa gago jwa SQRL go na le lefoko la sephiri. Bo tsenye fano gangwe ka moreki wa gago wa SQRL; o ka bo tlosa fano nako nngwe le nngwe.
sqrl-add: Tsenya boitshupo jwa me jwa SQRL
sqrl-added: Boitshupo jwa gago jwa SQRL bo tsentswe.
sqrl-none: Ga go na boitshupo jwa SQRL jo bo tsentsweng.
sqrl-remove: Tlosa boitshupo jwa me jwa SQRL
sqrl-disabled-by-client: Go tsena ka SQRL go thibetswe mo akhaontong e go tswa mo morekeng wa gago wa SQRL. Go bulele gape koo ka khoutu ya gago ya pholoso.
sqrl-only-on: Moreki wa gago wa SQRL o notlelele akhaonto e mo SQRL fela: ditsela tsotlhe tse dingwe tsa go tsena di a ganwa.
sqrl-hardlock-on: Moreki wa gago wa SQRL o notlelele akhaonto e ka thata: go baakanya lefoko la sephiri sešwa le go fetola imeile go a ganwa.
sqrl-only: Akhaonto e e tsena ka SQRL fela.
sqrl-hardlock: Akhaonto e e notleletswe mo SQRL: ga e kake ya busediwa kgotsa ya fetolwa ka tsela epe e nngwe.
windows-sso-failed: Go tsena ka Windows go paletse. Akhaonto ya gago ya Windows e ka tswa e sa letlelelwe fano.
